prompt:
CONCEPT: a citizen of the Carbon Nation, of the Graphite House. A female personification character with a wooden pencil with a graphite core, sharpened as her motif — the object reimagined as a woman in cloth and ornament that carry its materials, colors, shape and motifs. She does NOT hold, carry or wield the object; it is not a separate object. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.
ELEMENT TRAITS of Carbon (C) to carry in her design and the scene: two faces of one element: black soot and clear diamond; hexagonal lattices (graphite, graphene) as patterns, pencil-graphite grey, carbon-fibre weave; it bonds with everything and is the frame of all life. Palette: charcoal black, graphite grey, diamond white, a single living green.
HOUSE TRAITS of Graphite: silvery-grey pencil lead, flaking layered sheen, soft smudged shading. Palette: graphite grey, paper cream, cedar wood, black.
AGE: about twenty — a fresh young-adult face; no facial lines.
SILHOUETTE: lean and long-legged, with a natural neck length build; long straight hair with side-swept bangs; cedar-brown hair.
FACE — she must read as her own person at a glance, NOT the style's default pretty face and not a sister of the other characters: first impression — a cute, bright-eyed sweetness; olive skin; long face; moderately sized, realistically proportioned eyes — wide almond eyes, level outer eye corners; soft rounded brows; upturned nose; small bow lips; graphite-grey eyes; a dusting of freckles across nose and cheeks.
WORLD — FANTASY: a charcoal-burner's forest and a diamond mine: hexagonal crystal caves, smoking charcoal kilns, a world tree with lattice-patterned bark. COSTUME (citizen, fantasy): her object leads — its silhouette, parts and materials must read at first glance in her outfit and headpiece, the object reimagined as cloth, forged pieces and ornament; the fantasy era only sets the period cut and finish — cloth, leather, forged metal, subtle magical glow. No corset, no modern material, no machinery. LIGHT: natural daylight or the world's own magical glow, unless TIME & WEATHER says otherwise.
STYLE: Polished 2.5D game key art with clean linework, anime facial design that keeps each character's own facial structure, eye proportions and skin tone instead of one house face, layered cel-to-soft shading and crisp costume and prop detail. Use a vivid, readable silhouette and campaign-quality lighting.
EXPOSURE (bold): her outfit opens to show skin — a deep open neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders or arms, a high slit or a short hem where the outfit allows; pieces stay symmetrical. Nothing slipped off. Chest and pelvis covered; no corset; keep the object's shape, material and palette.
OUTPUT: one character image that works as card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame with clear margins, face turned toward the camera (front or three-quarter). Standing, card-ready pose; the environment may be rich while her design stays fully readable.
EXPRESSION: gaze angled down and away, slightly furrowed brow, lips lightly pressed or touched.
BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose or the frame.
ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no living creature, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border. No text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (C) and atomic number (6) — those two may appear readably (engraved, stamped, glowing or on a sign or label); nothing else is written.
ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, both hands drawn correctly as hands. No extra limbs.

No logo, watermark or border; readable main symbols are limited to C and 6.
